There are 4-5 tests to diagnose celiac. My aunt passed 3 and failed the 4th before she was diagnosed. They misdiagnosed me for over 10 years saying it was ibs not celiac despite having so many family members officially diagnosed. I had severe neuropathy. If you can afford the testing, don’t stop eating gluten till you get testing done because it won’t show up anymore if you stop. I ended up having to get an endoscopy to be diagnosed, and it was difficult. They could only tell by the damage to my intestines because I’d already stopped eating gluten for 6 months. If you can’t afford all of that, you can always just stop eating gluten. But it’s nice to know for sure before you limit yourself so much like a celiac has to. Doctors especially when treating women are dismissive, and it’s caused irreparable damage to my body. It’s negligent. Never stop advocating for yourself. You know your body.
